Window curtains | v1

Today, with a curtain on each panel

The title bar splits over the panels: each panel's name sits above it with a roll-up triangle. World window: Ground (the containers) and Maps.

Containers rolled up | the map alone

The containers roll up under their title like a minimized window; the window keeps its full width and the map stays put. Pressing the tab rolls them back down.

Inventory rolled up too | a minimap at the top right

With no tab open the Character window is only its title bar. The Inventory tab still takes drops, and the map works as a minimap.
